body:
Worker cf5799f6d38b (root + optimizer_advance) claims the currently unowned TasteTable soft-food evidence seam on main `a77175501199ace765cb7ca57742b267351d3e79`, tree `2031698fbc8fcf94ad9af06117c2d9858bc83190`; existing constraints module blob `cab2cecbe4c3a6112022d194a927b9025ec67ab6`.

The pinned baseline reproduces negative wording being credited as affirmative soft-food evidence: `no soup` and `soup unavailable` produce a “Soft foods: pass” label, and `burger` plus `no soup` bypasses the existing firm-food exclusion. The actual run_agent → scripted model → existing fixture transport → checks → assembled plan path reproduces that inclusion using fictional FIX-P-03 only. The affirmative `burger` + `soup` control is retained. Baseline native receipt SHA256: `4317ab903dd19b8364c19e4525ae649c822315b95584a7d552697cc02b59c6c2`.

Source fence: existing `check_soft_foods`, one private affirmative-cue helper in the same constraints module, focused tests and narrow documentation/evidence. Preserve the existing cue lexicons, unknown-is-permitted policy, affirmative-soft precedence and outing behavior. The already-merged wheelchair and low-sodium work remains exact. No provider, model, account or service changes are in scope.

Fresh coordination found no current owner for this seam; TasteTable #16 contact worksheet and #26 offline-week Save/Open remain with their owners. Implementation and native receiving will stay isolated; root retains GitHub mutation/integration.
